images.title: Who ends with more?
images.purpose: Show that only the small gaps matter: one starts 1 ahead, the other gains 3 more.
images.composition: Two horizontal bars stacked one above the other, left aligned, sketched not to scale, with the two small gaps highlighted.
exact_structure: Top bar labelled Raja: a teal #0072B2 start segment labelled 1023, then an amber #E69F00 gain segment labelled +125.
Bottom bar labelled Joy: a teal start segment labelled 1022, then an amber gain segment labelled +128.
Raja's teal segment is slightly longer than Joy's, the difference shown as a small reddish purple #CC79A7 piece at its right end labelled +1.
Joy's amber segment is longer than Raja's, the difference shown as a reddish purple piece at its right end labelled +3.
Both bars begin at the same left edge. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: Raja's start segment not longer than Joy's
Joy's gain segment not longer than Raja's
more than two reddish purple pieces
images.takeaway: Compare the small differences, a gap of 1 against a gap of 3, not the big totals.
images.description: Two bars show Raja starting 1 marble ahead and Joy gaining 3 more.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text on comparing sums.
images.teaching_notes: Look at the two purple pieces only: which one is bigger?

image_decisions.why: A visual of the start gap and the gain gap makes the reasoning visible.
